Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing A or b → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
